XIAO_TU_CARD_RUSTY_DICE.title: 锈蚀骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_STRIKE.title: 好运打击
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_STRIKE.description: 重投随机1枚骰子，造成{Damage:diff()}加上该骰子点数的伤害。
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_DEFEND.title: 好运防御
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_DEFEND.description: 重投随机1枚骰子，获得{Block:diff()}加上该骰子点数的[gold]格挡[/gold]。
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_BARRAGE.title: 骰子弹幕
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_BARRAGE.description: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}加上总骰点的伤害。
XIAO_TU_CARD_PLASTIC_DICE.title: 塑料骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_PLASTIC_DICE.description: 获得2枚临时骰子，然后重投所有骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_LEAD_DICE.title: 灌铅骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_LEAD_DICE.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害，获得1枚临时骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_IS_RIGHT.title: 偶数是对的
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_IS_RIGHT.description: 随机造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害，每有1枚骰子点数为偶数，额外造成1次伤害。
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_IS_RIGHT.title: 奇数是对的
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_IS_RIGHT.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]，每有1枚骰子点数为奇数，额外获得1次格挡。
XIAO_TU_CARD_HASTY_BITE.title: 兔急咬人
XIAO_TU_CARD_HASTY_BITE.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。重投1枚随机骰子并押大，若成功则获得1点力量。
XIAO_TU_CARD_NIMBLE_HARE.title: 动如脱兔
XIAO_TU_CARD_NIMBLE_HARE.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。重投1枚随机骰子并押大，若成功则获得1点敏捷。
XIAO_TU_CARD_SINGLE_DRAW_MIRACLE.title: 单抽出奇迹
XIAO_TU_CARD_SINGLE_DRAW_MIRACLE.descrip: 重投1枚随机骰子，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
XIAO_TU_CARD_EXCHANGE_CHIPS.title: 兑换筹码
XIAO_TU_CARD_EXCHANGE_CHIPS.description: 获得{Energy:diff()}点能量。重投1枚随机骰子并押大，若成功则抽1张牌。升级后改为点数最低的骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_NO_BEATING.title: 保证不打人
XIAO_TU_CARD_NO_BEATING.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。质押1枚骰子3回合。
XIAO_TU_CARD_LET_YOU_HIT.title: 保证让你打
XIAO_TU_CARD_LET_YOU_HIT.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。质押1枚骰子3回合。
XIAO_TU_CARD_ALL_IN.title: 倾囊而出
XIAO_TU_CARD_ALL_IN.description: 质押所有骰子3回合（升级：2回合），每质押1枚抽2张牌。
XIAO_TU_CARD_FORCED_LIQUIDATION.title: 强制平仓
XIAO_TU_CARD_FORCED_LIQUIDATION.descript: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}加上质押前总骰点的伤害。质押所有骰子3回合（升级：2回合）。
XIAO_TU_CARD_DEAD_PLEDGE.title: 死当
XIAO_TU_CARD_DEAD_PLEDGE.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。质押2枚骰子99回合（升级：1枚）。
XIAO_TU_CARD_IRON_SLASH.title: 铁斩波骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_IRON_SLASH.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。重投1枚随机骰子并押大，若成功则获得{Block}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。升级后改为点数最低的骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_LUCKY_BOOST.title: 好运加码
XIAO_TU_CARD_ADD_STAKE.title: 加注！
XIAO_TU_CARD_ADD_STAKE.description: 失去{Gold}金币，获得1枚临时骰子，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
XIAO_TU_CARD_MORE_STAKE.title: 再加注！！
XIAO_TU_CARD_MORE_STAKE.description: 失去{Gold}金币，获得临时骰子至上限，然后重投所有骰子。消耗。
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAY_TO_WIN.title: Pay2Win
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAY_TO_WIN.description: 重投所有骰子，失去{Gold}金币，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
XIAO_TU_CARD_SPARE_ME.title: 饶我一命
XIAO_TU_CARD_GRAND_SALE.title: 大酬宾
XIAO_TU_CARD_GRAND_SALE.description: 获得{Gold:diff()}×总骰点的金币。消耗。
XIAO_TU_CARD_GOLDEN_DICE.title: 金骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_GOLDEN_DICE.description: 获得1枚骰子并获得{Gold:diff()}金币。消耗。
XIAO_TU_CARD_TIP_PLEASE.title: 请给小费
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_STRIKE.title: 投骰一击
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_STRIKE.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}加上总骰点的伤害。
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_GUARD.title: 投骰护身
XIAO_TU_CARD_DICE_GUARD.description: 获得{Block:diff()}加上总骰点的[gold]格挡[/gold]。
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAIR_UP.title: 对子
XIAO_TU_CARD_PAIR_UP.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]；若存在点数相同的骰子，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_ROLL.title: 奇数滚
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_ROLL.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]；重投所有奇数骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_CLIMB.title: 偶数爬
XIAO_TU_CARD_EVEN_CLIMB.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害；重投所有偶数骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_PRESS_ADVANTAGE.title: 乘胜追击
XIAO_TU_CARD_PRESS_ADVANTAGE.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害；重投1枚随机骰子并押大，若成功则再造成一次伤害。
XIAO_TU_CARD_TRY_ROLL.title: 试手一掷
XIAO_TU_CARD_TRY_ROLL.description: 重投{Amount:diff()}枚随机骰子，抽1张牌。消耗。
XIAO_TU_CARD_TEMPORARY_CUSTODY.title: 暂时保管
XIAO_TU_CARD_TEMPORARY_CUSTODY.descripti: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。质押1枚骰子2回合。
XIAO_TU_CARD_SELL_DICE.title: 售卖骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_SELL_DICE.description: 质押1枚骰子99回合，获得{Gold}金币。消耗。
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_EVEN_ALL.title: 单双通吃
XIAO_TU_CARD_ODD_EVEN_ALL.description: 每有1枚奇数骰子，获得{Amount:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]；每有1枚偶数骰子，对随机敌人造成{Amount:diff()}点伤害。
XIAO_TU_CARD_MAKE_IT_EVEN.title: 凑成双
XIAO_TU_CARD_MAKE_IT_EVEN.description: 所有奇数骰子点数+1，抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。
XIAO_TU_CARD_FLUSH.title: 清一色
XIAO_TU_CARD_FLUSH.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害；若所有骰子奇偶性相同，抽等同于骰子数量的牌。
XIAO_TU_CARD_REVERSAL.title: 否极泰来
XIAO_TU_CARD_REVERSAL.description: 反转每枚骰子的点数：1与6互换、2与5互换、3与4互换。
XIAO_TU_CARD_STRAIGHT.title: 顺子
XIAO_TU_CARD_STRAIGHT.description: 若存在至少3枚点数连续的骰子，获得2点能量并抽{Cards:diff()}张牌，随后重投所有骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_LAST_GAMBLE.title: 孤注一掷
XIAO_TU_CARD_LAST_GAMBLE.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害；你每有1枚骰子，伤害降低{Amount:diff()}点。
XIAO_TU_CARD_FOLLOW_THE_CROWD.title: 跟风
XIAO_TU_CARD_FOLLOW_THE_CROWD.descriptio: 重投所有骰子，然后点数最低的骰子变为与点数最高的骰子相同。
XIAO_TU_CARD_WISH_COME_TRUE.title: 心想事成
XIAO_TU_CARD_WISH_COME_TRUE.description: 随机{Amount:diff()}枚骰子的点数+3（最高为6）。
XIAO_TU_CARD_SIX_SIX_SIX.description: 随机重投1枚点数不为6的骰子，共3次。升级：每次重投所有点数不为6的骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_CACTUS_DICE.title: 仙人掌骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_CACTUS_DICE.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]，获得1枚临时骰子，并获得等同于其点数的荆棘。
XIAO_TU_CARD_METEOR_DICE.title: 流星锤骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_METEOR_DICE.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害，获得1枚临时骰子，并对敌人赋予等同于其点数的易伤。
XIAO_TU_CARD_STONE_DICE.title: 石头骰子
XIAO_TU_CARD_STONE_DICE.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]，获得1枚临时骰子。
XIAO_TU_CARD_SINGLE_BENEFIT.title: 单数福利
XIAO_TU_CARD_SINGLE_BENEFIT.description: 你的回合结束时，每有1枚奇数骰子，获得{Amount:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
XIAO_TU_CARD_CHOSEN_ONE.title: 天选之人
XIAO_TU_CARD_CHOSEN_ONE.description: 每回合开始时，你点数最低的那枚骰子会被再重投一次。
